source.format: flat CSV, UTF-8 with BOM, comma-delimited, 12 columns, 35 data records, embedded newlines inside quoted fields
source.hashVerifiedBy: Python standard-library hashlib.sha256 over plaintext binary stream
source.hashVerificationNote: In this runtime the Windows pwsh file layer (Get-FileHash, certutil, [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes, Get-Content) returns a DIFFERENT byte stream for this same path at the same length, hashing to c87e601534d5d4cacea3a68793585473874cf541c44c4e10b68f1dd34485a5c5. python hashlib and the harness read tool independently agree on b92d203fa6f152120a316b9e32c037f7c1c978e96424edf5a871f02e5cfe0fd4, which is the authoritative digest per the Commander ruling in team/artifacts/tm109-direct-trial/captain-ruling-001-input-hash.md. The pwsh reading is an environment artifact and is NOT a property of DFT.csv.

rawIntent.description: Verbatim DFT fields for TM109. No interpretation, expansion or completion applied.

pinConditions.argSemantics: DFT.csv does not label the vset/iset arguments. Argument vectors are recorded positionally and verbatim; this artifact assigns no meaning (voltage, current limit, range, unit) to any argument position.

limits.boundForm: descriptive threshold specification written as text; DFT.csv states no numeric minimum/maximum pass-fail bounds for this item
limits.asWrittenDerivation: decomposed verbatim from the ExpectValue text; quantity labels are the DFT's own wording; no value was added, computed or inferred

dftRegisterConfig.note: Field annotations are the DFT's own trailing comments, recorded verbatim. DFT.csv supplies no register map, so field names, widths and values are neither re-derived nor expanded here.

explicitRelations.note: DFT.csv presents the three field groups in the column order above and enumerates the Dynamic steps in document order. DFT.csv contains no statement that any Dynamic transition interleaves with the Software_initial writes, so this artifact asserts no interleaving and no timing relationship between the groups.

parseStatus.emptyCellSemantics: recorded as empty strings exactly as present in the source; not filled in, not inferred

openItems.description: Resolved by user ruling VAC2 authoritative and canonical source correction: TM109 Dynamic now drives vac2 in all four steps. The prior vac3 observation is retained as provenance.

corroboratingLocators.value: vac1 present in TM105, TM108, TM114, TM116, TM439_1; vac2 present in no record; vac3 present in TM109, TM110, TM624
